verdict.rationale: Adyen documents balance accounts per user/seller, split payment instructions (including fee/commission deduction to a liable balance account), managed/custom payouts, and Adyen-generated reports for bookkeeping/reconciliation — directly supporting per-seller and platform-fee balance legibility and traceability. However, there's no evidence of penny-level reconciliation reports, ledger/general-ledger detail, or double-entry audit trail specifics, nor independent confirmation that reconciliation is exact-to-the-cent in practice. Missing for 10: detailed ledger/report schema evidence, explicit penny-level reconciliation guarantees, and independent/third-party corroboration of reconciliation accuracy.
